arxiv-1410-6508.title: Centroid Velocity Statistics of Molecular Clouds
arxiv-1410-6508.creator: Erik Bertram, Lukas Konstandin, Rahul Shetty, Simon C. O. Glover, Ralf S. Klessen
arxiv-1410-6508.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Erik Bertram, Lukas Konstandin, Rahul Shetty, Simon C. O. Glover, Ralf S. Klessen. We compute structure functions and Fourier spectra of 2D centroid velocity (CV) maps in order to study the gas dynamics of typical molecular clouds (MCs) in numerical simulations. We account for a simplified treatment of time-dependent chemistry and the non-isothermal nature of the gas and use a 3D radiative transfer tool to model the CO line emission in a post-processing step.

arxiv-2011-14178.creator: Fabian Müller, Akaki Rusetsky, Tiansu Yu
arxiv-2011-14178.description: Abstract Using the framework of nonrelativistic effective field theory, the finite-volume ground-state energy shift is calculated up to and including O ⁡ ( L − 6 ) O(L^{-6}) for the system of three pions in the channel with the total isospin I = 1 I=1 .

arxiv-2105-00344.creator: Subhasis Samanta, Tobiasz Czopowicz, Marek Gazdzicki
arxiv-2105-00344.description: Abstract A search for power-law fluctuations within the framework of the intermittency method is ongoing to locate the critical point of the strongly interacting matter. In particular, experimental data on proton and pion production in heavy-ion collisions are analyzed in transverse-momentum, p T p_{T} , space.

arxiv-2108-09607.title: Approximating Orbits in a Rotating Gravity Field with Oblateness and Ellipticity Perturbations
arxiv-2108-09607.creator: Ethan Burnett, Hanspeter Schaub
arxiv-2108-09607.description: Abstract This paper explores the problem of analytically approximating the orbital state for a subset of orbits in a rotating potential with oblateness and ellipticity perturbations. This is done by isolating approximate differential equations for the orbit radius and other elements. The conservation of the Jacobi integral is used to make the problem solvable to first-order in the perturbations.

arxiv-2209-10038.title: Quantum Fluid Dynamics on the Hypersphere
arxiv-2209-10038.creator: Stuart B. Heinrich
arxiv-2209-10038.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Stuart B. Heinrich. It is known from quantum mechanics that particles are associated with wave functions, and that the probability of observing a particle at some future location is proportional to the squared modulus of the amplitude of its wave function. Although this statistical relationship is well quantified, the interpretations have remained controversial, with many split between the classical Copenhagen interpretation and some variation of the de Broglie-Bohm pilot wave models.

arxiv-2305-00760.title: Breaks and Code Quality: Investigating the Impact of Forgetting on Software Development Registered Report
arxiv-2305-00760.creator: Dario Amoroso d’Aragona, Luca Pascarella, Andrea Janes, Valentina Lenarduzzi, Rafael Peñaloza, Davide Taibi
arxiv-2305-00760.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Dario Amoroso d’Aragona, Luca Pascarella, Andrea Janes, Valentina Lenarduzzi, Rafael Peñaloza, Davide Taibi. Developers interrupting their participation in a project might slowly forget critical information about the code, such as its intended purpose, structure, the impact of external dependencies, and the approach used for implementation. Forgetting the implementation details can have detrimental effects on software maintenance, comprehension, knowledge sharing, and developer productivity, resulting in bugs, and other issues that can negatively influence the software development process.

arxiv-2311-06747.title: Graph Frequency Features of Cancer Gene Co-Expression Networks PubID: pubid: 0000–0000/00$00.00 © 2024 IEEE
arxiv-2311-06747.creator: Radwa Adel, and Ercan Engin Kuruoglu*
arxiv-2311-06747.description: Abstract Complex gene interactions play a significant role in cancer progression, driving cellular behaviors that contribute to tumor growth, invasion, and metastasis. Gene co-expression networks model the functional connectivity between genes under various biological conditions. Understanding the system-level evolution of these networks in cancer is critical for elucidating disease mechanisms and informing the development of targeted therapies.

arxiv-2405-07366.title: Unbounded order convergence on infinitely distributive lattices
arxiv-2405-07366.creator: Kevin Abela, Emmanuel Chetcuti
arxiv-2405-07366.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kevin Abela, Emmanuel Chetcuti. We study 𝔲 \mathfrak{u} O-convergence on infinitely distributive lattices, extending key properties known from Riesz spaces. We show that order continuity of 𝔲 \mathfrak{u} O-convergence characterizes infinite distributivity. We examine O-adherence and 𝔲 \mathfrak{u} O-adherence of sublattices and ideals, proving that the 𝔲 \mathfrak{u} O- and O-closures of a sublattice coincide and form a sublattice, and that the first 𝔲 \mathfrak{u} O-adherence of an ideal is an O-closed ideal.

arxiv-2411-19890.title: Reverse-type Data Processing Inequality
arxiv-2411-19890.creator: Paula Belzig, Li Gao, Graeme Smith, Peixue Wu
arxiv-2411-19890.description: Abstract The quantum data processing inequality asserts that two quantum states become harder to distinguish when a noisy channel is applied. On the other hand, a reverse quantum data processing inequality characterizes whether distinguishability is preserved after the application of a noisy channel.

arxiv-2602-05563.title: A term-by-term variational multiscale method with dynamic subscales for incompressible turbulent aerodynamics Journal: ArXiv
arxiv-2602-05563.creator: D. Escobar 1,2 , D. Pacheco 3,4,5 , A. Aguirre 1,2 and E. Castillo 1,2, 1 Computational Heat and Fluid Flow Lab, Universidad de Santiago de Chile 2 Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Santiago de Chile, Santiago, Chile 3 Chair for Computational Analysis of Technical Systems, RWTH Aac
arxiv-2602-05563.description: Abstract Variational multiscale (VMS) methods offer a robust framework for handling under-resolved flow scales without resorting to problem-specific turbulence models. Here, we propose and assess a dynamic, term-by-term VMS stabilized formulation for simulating incompressible flows from laminar to turbulent regimes.

pmc-10742130.title: Beyond the Basics: Unraveling the Complexity of Coronary Artery Calcification
pmc-10742130.creator: Satwat Hashmi, Pashmina Wiqar Shah, Zouhair Aherrahrou, Elena Aikawa, Rédouane Aherrahrou
pmc-10742130.description: Coronary artery calcification (CAC) is mainly associated with coronary atherosclerosis, which is an indicator of coronary artery disease (CAD). CAC refers to the accumulation of calcium phosphate deposits, classified as micro- or macrocalcifications, that lead to the hardening and narrowing of the coronary arteries. CAC is a strong predictor of future cardiovascular events, such as myocardial infarction and sudden death.

pmc-12365027.title: Metabolic dysfunction impairs Mycobacterium tuberculosis-specific cytokine and chemokine responses in latent tuberculosis and type 2 diabetes mellitus

pmc-12365027.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (DM) is associated with impaired host immune responses, increasing the risk for latent tuberculosis (TB) infection (LTBI). This study investigated how DM and associated metabolic dysfunction alter Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb)-specific cytokine and chemokine responses. We analysed a cohort of 164 participants with and without DM and/or LTBI.

pmc-12454655.creator: Vlora Riberdy, Alessandro Guida, James Rioux, Kimberly Brewer
pmc-12454655.description: Radiomics-based analyses are increasingly being applied to clinical studies. pmc-12506941.description: ObjectiveAcupuncture is recognized as an effective migraine treatment, but the comparative long‐term efficacy of different acupuncture methods at identical acupoints remains unclear. pmc-12609695.title: Modern Developing Directions in the Dihydroquercetin Study
pmc-12609695.creator: Svetlana Yu Filippovich, Elena P Isakova, Galina P Bachurina, Yulia I Deryabina, Maria Luisa Di Gioia, Oana Maria Dragostin
pmc-12609695.description: Dihydroquercetin (taxifolin) is a natural bioflavonoid with diverse biological activities, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, antiviral, and geroprotective effects. The review summarizes current advances in the research of dihydroquercetin with a focus on its structural features, physicochemical properties, and biological functions. Particular attention is drawn to its low solubility and limited bioavailability, which have stimulated the development of nanotechnology-based delivery systems.

pmc-13273765.title: Associations between organizational cynicism, workplace alienation, and nurses’ work effectiveness: A cross-sectional questionnaire survey

pmc-13273765.description: BackgroundThe effectiveness of the nursing workforce is critical for patient safety and quality of care, yet nurses often face high-stress environments that can foster negative psychosocial states.
